about: Reviewed starting inputs for the font-cmap target. The first byte picks the character map format (value modulo 6: 0, 4, 6, 10, 12, 13; bit 3 glyph arrays for format 4; bit 4 code points past U+FFFF for formats 10 and 12); each further byte (up to 32) chooses one range: its distance from the last (low 2 bits), its length (next 3 bits) and its first glyph. The font is built from 2 and 16 copies of the ranges.

seeds.why: format 0, no ranges chosen: one range from byte 0
format 0 with ranges, some past 255 dropped
format 10 in the Basic Multilingual Plane
format 13: whole ranges to one glyph
ranges that map to glyph 0 (bytes divisible by 11) and glyphs past the font
adjacent one-character ranges (byte 0: no gap, length 1)
